Setting up of rooftop helipads
*261. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
SHRI N.R. GOVINDA-
RAJAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is mandatory to seek
approval of Director General, Civil Aviation
(DGCA) for construction of rooftop
helipads;
(b) if so, the details of guidelines in this
regard;
(c) the names of individuals/companies
who have been given permission to
construct rooftop helipads in Mumbai and
Delhi; and
(d) the number of applications pending,
with names of corporate houses/
individuals?
Credit flow to MSMEs
*262. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is increasing
the credit flow from commercial banks to
the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
(MSMEs);
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to give special packages to each
State in this regard, especially in Andhra
Pradesh;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the present position thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Supply of LPG in the Country
†*263. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the names of those States in the
country, in respect of which Government
is aware of shortage of LPG therein;
(b) the quantum of LPG being allocated
in the country, State-wise; and

85
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether allocation of LPG for those
States would be enhanced in the  current
year, where such allocation is not done as
per their requirement?
Upgradation of airports in Gujarat
*264. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL:  Wi ll the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal for
upgradation of Rajkot airport is under
consideration of Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is also a proposal
under consideration for a new international
terminal building complex at Ahmedabad;
(d) if so, the progress made in this
regard; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Foreign Financial Institutions in
stock markets
†*265. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that after
imposition of a ban on ‘Participatory Notes’
in the share markets of the country by
Government, there has been an increase in
the number of Foreign Financial Institutions
engaged in trading in share markets;
(b) if so, whether the number of
accounts associated therewith has also
increased; and
(c) if so, the respective number of
Foreign Financial Institutions and accounts
associated therewith in the middle of
November, 2007?
Insurance for income-tax payer
†*266. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to insure every income-tax payer for an
amount of ten lakhs rupees;
(b) if so, the date from which it would
be introduced; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Delay in infrastructure projects
*267. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of infrastructure projects
initiated during the last three years and since
completed and the number of projects
facing delays;
(b) whether it is a fact that delay is
driving up costs substantially;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
infrastructure projects in sectors like
Roads, Power, Petroleum, Coal, Aviation,
Steel and Urban Development are running
behind schedule and driving up costs
substantially;
(d) if so, whether Government is taking
any steps for their timely completion; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Task Force for interlinking of rivers
†*268. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Task

86
Force constituted for interlinking of rivers
has been dissolved;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the suggestions of the Task Force in
this regard?
Participation of private sector in
training of pilots
*269. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has made an
assessment of prospective need for
commercial pilots in civil aviation sector in
the country;
(b) if so, whether the country has world
class training institutes to meet the
prospective requirement of trained
commercial pilots;
(c) the current strength of the existing
civil aviation academies/campuses in the
country;
(d) whether Government propose to
enhance the

Setting up international airport in
Jharkhand
†1475.SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any plan for
constructing any international level airport
at any place besides Ranchi in Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government
proposes to take any initiative in this
regard?
Issue of NOC to domestic airlines
1476. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of applications pending
for NOC for scheduled domestic airlines
for more than one year;
(b) the precise reasons that these
applications have not been processed for
more than one year;
(c) whether Government is aware that
companies desirous of seeking NOC have
invested large amount on these projects;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government
proposes to take for speedy processing of
these applications?
Magazines provided during flight
†1477. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the magazines in
English, Hindi and other language being
supplied in Aircrafts during flights;
(b) the comparative percentage of these
magazines, language-wise;
(c) whether there has been the pre-
eminence of English magazines; and
(d) if so, who is responsible for this
violation of Official Language Act/Rules
and what action would be taken by
Government against them?
Basic requirements for regional airlines
1478. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) what is the action plan of Centre to
promote regional airlines to boost
connectivity with small and medium towns/
cities; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

352
(b) what are the basic requirements
which have to be met before an enterprise
is allowed to become a regional airline?
Permission to Jet Airways to fly in
Gulf-sector
1479. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Group of
Ministers (GoMs) is deliberating various
issues relating to aviation sector;
(b) whether it is also a fact that without
waiting for the recommendations of the
GoMs, Government has granted
permission to Jet Airways, a private airlines
to fly on lucrative Gulf routes;
(c) if so, what are the details thereof and
the reasons therefor; and
(d) what will be the financial impact on
Indian and Air India by granting permission
to the Jet Airways?
Setting up of multiple airports in metro
cities
1480. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to set up multiple airports in
metropolitan cities to reduce congestion at
existing airports and cater to the increasing
air traffic;
(b) if so, which are the cities where these
airports are likely to be set up;
(c) whether Government will be able
to set up these airports before the
Commonwealth Games 2010; and
(d) if not, how Government will be able
to tackle the heavy traffic of chartered and
private planes over the skies of major
cities?
Workers engaged at airports
†1481. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether contract workers, daily
wagers, casual labours working on airports
have submitted any memorandum to
Government regarding their wages and
other facilities;
(b) whether Government is considering
to regularize them;
(c) whether Ministry has any proposal
to provide at least consolidated pay to these
poor workers; and
(d) if so, by when it would be provided
and amount thereof?
Use of redundant airports
1482. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India (AAI) has any plans to encourage the
establishment of pilot training academies
in Hyderabad;
(b) whether it is a fact that redundant
Airports could be used for such
development of aviation infrastructure; and
(c) the details of steps the AAI would
take to preserve, develop and nurture
aviation infrastructure in the country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

353
Extension of Jammu Airport
1483. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal to extend the Jammu Airport;
(b) if so, the details of land which has
been acquired recently; and
(c) the fund sanctioned in this regard?
Limit of number of foreign pilots
